_comment: Example for `mapgen procgen --params data/procgen/example-temperate.json --out <dir>` (R-UI-01, section 14 «Срединные земли»): 30 × 24 hexes of 10 km, temperate biome. City names are locale keys (no texts yet); hint = preferred hex [col, row], the city goes to the best hex nearby; cities without a hint are placed by the generator. origin = lon/lat of the north-west corner (geometry only).
